propositions: The public API rebar.llm.review_ticket() was removed in a pre-1.0 breaking change but two external live test modules were not retargeted, causing AttributeError in 4 CI lanes.

test_pydantic_ai_cutover_live.py and test_llm_trace.py still call the removed review_ticket() function which was deprecated and mapped to review_plan/review_code but these modules were excluded from the Verified gate and the removal epic's pytest run.

The retarget decision was to move both modules to rebar.llm.review_code (not review_plan) because review_code returns REVIEW_RESULT with runner/model/findings fields matching the tests' assertions, whereas review_plan returns PLAN_REVIEW_VERDICT with no top-level findings.

Retargeting both call sites to review_code with REBAR_VERIFY_ENABLE_CODE_REVIEW enabled restores the external LLM live test lanes to green and validates the result contract (runner, model, findings present).
